newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Sept 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Sept 8.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi Arabia gives Palestinians 3.8 million riyals.
- Trade exchanges between Saudi Arabia and India were worth four billion riyals in 1995.
- Gulf Arab states to map out security strategy. Foreign ministers of the Gulf Cooperation Council met in Riyadh on Saturday.
- Saudi ports handled 87 million tonnes in 1994.
- Saudi investors to get priority in Uzbekistan.
- South Korea launches drive to seek an increased volume of investment from Saudi Arabia.
- Japanese technical mission arrives in Saudi to study the possible framework of technical cooperation.
